name: Citizenship by Descent

requirements.blocker_text: Under Zimbabwe's 2013 Constitution, a person is a citizen by birth if born in Zimbabwe OR abroad, and either their mother, their father, OR ANY of their grandparents was a Zimbabwean citizen. This is an unusually broad, gender-neutral, grandparent-reaching descent rule -- a significant liberalization from the pre-2013 Citizenship Act, which recognized only a parent's (not grandparent's) citizenship, and only through the father except in narrow illegitimacy cases.

evidence_required.document: Parent's or grandparent's proof of Zimbabwean citizenship

sources.title: Stateless Hub -- Zimbabwe's 2013 Constitution's grandparent-reaching, gender-neutral descent rule, superseding the older 1984 Citizenship Act's father-line-only approach

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Zimbabwe). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to a tier-3 statelessness-research hub; the Constitution's own government-gazette text (or a citizenshiprightsafrica.org corroborating source) was not independently re-fetched for this specific file. GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE, UNUSUALLY GENEROUS FINDING: extending automatic descent citizenship to GRANDPARENTS (not just parents) is broader than nearly every other descent rule built in this dataset -- most countries stop at the parent generation. The source flags an unresolved wrinkle: whether citizens-by-descent-through-a-grandparent can themselves transmit citizenship to a further generation born abroad is described as unclear/not yet tested. dual_citizenship_allowed set true per the 2013 Constitution's express allowance for citizens BY BIRTH -- but see zw_citizenship_naturalisation.json's notes for the significant caveat that this constitutional allowance directly conflicts with the still-unamended 1984 Citizenship Act, which bans dual citizenship outright, and that administrative practice reportedly continues enforcing the OLD ban despite the newer constitutional text. This live legal conflict is the single most important finding in this Zimbabwe build and is disclosed consistently across all three citizenship files rather than picking one answer and hiding the contradiction.
